name: Coin Scribble / Mintfunnel

sources.title: Homepage — now branded 'Mintfunnel', a self-serve Web3 marketing platform (native ads + PR distribution + analytics); © 2026 CB Platforms LLC

requirements: Site pivoted from 'Coin Scribble' to Mintfunnel: a paid crypto/Web3 marketing platform, not a directory
PR distribution starts at $99 per release with tiered pricing by number of publications
Native ad network runs on a CPC model from $0.25/click with no minimum budget ($10 suggested start)
Audience is crypto/Web3 only (DeFi, tokens, NFTs, chains, exchanges, DAOs) — a non-crypto SaaS is a poor fit
Free tier exists only for Mintfunnel Analytics (site-side tracking) — it produces no public listing
preparation: A crypto/Web3-relevant product announcement — the publisher network is crypto media only
Press release copy (or use their free PR generator tool)
Budget: ≥$99 for PR distribution or a CPC budget for native ads
Account at app.mintfunnel.co (email signup, no credit card claimed for the free analytics tier)
workflow: Choose PR Distribution (≥$99/release, tiered by outlet count) or Ad Network (CPC, from $0.25)
Write/upload the release or ad creative in the guided flow
Submit — campaigns reportedly go live within minutes with no approval queue
Track placements/clicks in the dashboard; guaranteed pickups are stated per PR tier
watchFor: This is no longer a listing directory — catalog entry should be treated as a paid PR/ads channel
Batch URL /contact is dead; there is no free submission path
Crypto-only publisher network; general SaaS products will not fit the audience
The 'free' analytics plan does not get your product published anywhere
countsAsLive: The dashboard shows the press release 'Published' with live pickups across named crypto outlets, or the ad campaign shows live impressions/clicks
unknowns: Whether 'Coin Scribble' branding or a legacy editorial/contact route still exists anywhere on the domain
Exact per-tier publication lists for PR distribution
Whether a non-crypto product would be rejected or merely ineffective
